definitions.explanation: How satisfied people are with something, usually as measured in a survey: customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction, and so on. From {満足|まんぞく} (satisfaction) + 〜{度|ど} (degree).

examples.japanese: ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This hotel has high satisfaction ratings.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: According to the survey, user satisfaction rose from last year.

notes:
A business and survey word; it usually comes with a number or with ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}: customer satisfaction
- {満足度|まんぞくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: satisfaction is high / low
- {満足度|まんぞくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise satisfaction
- {満足度|まんぞくど}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: satisfaction survey

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧: satisfaction
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧: dissatisfaction
